title: Dubois vs Wardley 2: Londoner retains title with dominant second-round stoppage - BBC
description: WBO champion Daniel Dubois underlines his status as Britain's leading heavyweight with a devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley.

title: 2 killed, multiple injured after vehicle drives onto field during soccer game at Wichita sports complex - CNN
description: Two people were killed and multiple others were injured when a vehicle drove onto a field during a soccer game at a sports complex in Wichita, Kansas, on Saturday, authorities said.
